svg.aria-label: Hungary in 1593, the year the codex counts to
svg.text: Hungary in 1593, the year the codex counts to
A kingdom in three parts, and the town the book is named for in its Habsburg west. Borders approximate.

g.data-desc: The codex's last leaves count one thousand five hundred and sixty years from the Ascension, which is 1593. That summer the Long Turkish War began between the Habsburgs and the Ottomans, and it ran until 1606. Rohonc lay about a hundred kilometres from the frontier at Kanizsa.
g.text: The codex's last leaves count 1,560 years
That summer the Long Turkish War began
kilometres from the frontier at Kanizsa.
